Messages.Author: Gregory Stuart Pettigrew
Messages.Body:
> How does Seeds of Corruption interact with all of Jacob's text.
>

Let's go line by line.

"Jacob's capacity is increased by 4 while he is controlled."

Vampires are normally unable to change their capacity. Snip.

"Your predator can use a master phase action to discard a master card to
force you to discard your hand. Draw back up to your hand size afterward."

Vampires are normally unable to give their predators wacky things to do.
Snip.

Jacob, The Glitch with a Seeds of Corruption should have a blank text box.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"XZealot" <nbr...@rapidretailsolutions.com> wrote:
> How does Seeds of Corruption interact with all of Jacob's text.

It leaves him with just "Sabbat" as active text.

(A Seeds on Tariq would have a similar effect, leaving him simply
"Idependent" and Blood Cursed as per the default state of his clan).
